tips.title: Track Daily
tips.body: Log every purchase the same day to avoid forgetting small expenses that add up quickly.

tips.title: 50/30/20 Rule
tips.body: Allocate 50% of income to needs, 30% to wants, and 20% to savings and investments.

tips.title: Emergency Fund
tips.body: Aim to save 3–6 months of living expenses as an emergency fund before investing.

tips.title: Review Weekly
tips.body: Spend 10 minutes every Sunday reviewing your week's spending and planning the next.

tips.title: Avoid Lifestyle Inflation
tips.body: When your income increases, keep expenses steady and route the difference to savings.

tips.title: Automate Savings
tips.body: Set up an automatic transfer to savings on payday so you save before you spend.

tips.title: Cut Subscriptions
tips.body: Audit subscriptions every quarter. Cancel anything you haven't used in 30 days.

tips.title: Meal Prep
tips.body: Cooking at home saves up to 60% compared to eating out. Prep meals on weekends.
